output.taskText:
It send me a message looking like this:
I found multiple files matching *"image"*. Which one did you mean?
  1. headshots.jpg
  2. remove_wmk1777068125257.png
Reply with the number or the exact filename.

Then when I say which one I want, it shows this message:
Failed to read file: File not found: C:\Users\KshitijModi\Downloads\Remote Engineering Agents\Headshots.jpg

planSteps.description: Find where file matches are listed in ButtonResponseHandler.js and FileMatching.js — verify that full file paths are stored alongside filenames when presenting options to the user
Trace the user's file selection through ButtonResponseHandler.js — ensure the selected file's full original path (from initialization) is preserved and passed to the file reading code
Check FileHandler.js for the file reading/sending logic — confirm it uses the full path provided from step 2, not a reconstructed path defaulting to REA folder
Identify where the filename case is being changed (headshots.jpg → Headshots.jpg) — likely in path normalization or filename processing in FileHandler.js or LinkProcessor.js
Update the file selection/response flow to retain the initialized directory path throughout — from listing files to reading and sending attachment
Add logging at each step (listing, selection, reading) to track whether the full path is preserved or lost
Test with a file from the initialized desktop path and verify the correct full path is used when reading the file
Verify that both REA folder files and initialized external paths work correctly after the fix
